73435-the-fighting-scrub.title: The Fighting Scrub
73435-the-fighting-scrub.creator: Ralph Henry Barbour
73435-the-fighting-scrub.description: A book by Ralph Henry Barbour. THE FIGHTING SCRUB 160  XV. TOM’S LUCK TURNS 170  XVI. LORING TAKES COMMAND 183  XVII. WATTLES USES COERCION 193   XVIII. A NEW PLAY IS TRIED OUT 205  XIX. “COCKY” MAKES A CALL 225  XXI. THE SCRUB DISBANDS 243   XXIII. WYNDHAM PLAYS WOLCOTT 254  XXIV.

arxiv-2009-06758.title: Accelerating Bayesian microseismic event location with deep learning
arxiv-2009-06758.description: Abstract We present a series of new open source deep learning algorithms to accelerate Bayesian full waveform point source inversion of microseismic events. Inferring the joint posterior probability distribution of moment tensor components and source location is key for rigorous uncertainty quantification.

arxiv-2109-09646.title: Unramified extensions of quadratic number fields with Galois group S ​ L 2 ​ ( 7 ) SL_{2}(7)
arxiv-2109-09646.creator: Joachim König
arxiv-2109-09646.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Joachim König. We provide an infinite family of quadratic number fields with everywhere unramified Galois extensions of Galois group S ​ L 2 ​ ( 7 ) SL_{2}(7) . To my knowledge, this is the first instance of infinitely many such realizations for a perfect group which is not generated by involutions, a property which makes it difficult to approach for the problem in question and leads to somewhat delicate local-global problems in inverse Galois theory. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
12F12; 11R21.

arxiv-2111-03904.title: On pseudo-absence generation and machine learning for locust breeding ground prediction in Africa
arxiv-2111-03904.creator: Ibrahim Salihu Yusuf, Kale-ab Tessera, Thomas Tumiel, Zohra Slim, Amine Kerkeni, Sella Nevo, Arnu Pretorius
arxiv-2111-03904.description: Abstract Desert locust outbreaks threaten the food security of a large part of Africa and have affected the livelihoods of millions of people over the years. Furthermore, these outbreaks could potentially become more severe and frequent as a result of global climate change.

arxiv-2304-00480.title: The Schwarzian derivative on Finsler manifolds of constant curvature
arxiv-2304-00480.creator: B. BIDABAD, F. SEDIGHI
arxiv-2304-00480.description: Abstract Lagrange introduced the notion of Schwarzian derivative and Thurston discovered its mysterious properties playing a role similar to that of curvature on Riemannian manifolds. Here we continue our studies on the development of the Schwarzian derivative on Finsler manifolds. First, we obtain an integrability condition for the Möbius equations.

arxiv-2304-01627.title: Self-Supervised Image Denoising for Real-World Images with Context-aware Transformer
arxiv-2304-01627.creator: DAN ZHANG 1, FANGFANG ZHOU 2
arxiv-2304-01627.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by DAN ZHANG 1, FANGFANG ZHOU 2. In recent years, the development of deep learning has been pushing image denoising to a new level. Among them, self-supervised denoising is increasingly popular because it does not require any prior knowledge. Most of the existing self-supervised methods are based on convolutional neural networks (CNN), which are restricted by the locality of the receptive field and would cause color shifts or textures loss.

arxiv-2402-01226.title: HW-SW Optimization of DNNs for Privacy-preserving People Counting on Low-resolution Infrared Arrays Thanks: This work has received funding from the ECSEL Joint Undertaking (JU) under grant agreement No 101007321. The JU receives support from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation
arxiv-2402-01226.creator: Matteo Risso 1 , Chen Xie 1 , Francesco Daghero 1 , Alessio Burrello 1 , Seyedmorteza Mollaei 1 , Marco Castellano 2 , Enrico Macii 1 , Massimo Poncino 1 , Daniele Jahier Pagliari 1
arxiv-2402-01226.description: Abstract Low-resolution infrared (IR) array sensors enable people counting applications such as monitoring the occupancy of spaces and people flows while preserving privacy and minimizing energy consumption. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have been shown to be well-suited to process these sensor data in an accurate and efficient manner.

arxiv-2501-07055.title: SFC-GAN : A Generative Adversarial Network for Brain Functional and Structural Connectome Translation
arxiv-2501-07055.creator: Yee-Fan Tan, Jun Lin Liow, Pei-Sze Tan, Fuad Noman, Raphaël C.-W. Phan, Hernando Ombao, Chee-Ming Ting
arxiv-2501-07055.description: Abstract Modern brain imaging technologies have enabled the detailed reconstruction of human brain connectomes, capturing structural connectivity (SC) from diffusion MRI and functional connectivity (FC) from functional MRI. Understanding the intricate relationships between SC and FC is vital for gaining deeper insights into the brain’s functional and organizational mechanisms.

arxiv-2509-08164.title: Disordered Charged Horizons
arxiv-2509-08164.creator: Daniel Areán, Sebastian Grieninger, Pau G. Romeu
arxiv-2509-08164.description: Abstract We construct fully backreacted charged black brane solutions with a spatially disordered chemical potential in asymptotically AdS 3 and AdS 4 , providing holographic duals of strongly coupled disordered systems. At intermediate temperatures these geometries display highly inhomogeneous horizons, though their geometric averages reproduce the clean BTZ and Reissner–Nordström solutions. The low temperature behavior, however, differs sharply between dimensions.

arxiv-2510-18769.title: Pre-perihelion Development of Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Note: 2025 October 23
arxiv-2510-18769.creator: David Jewitt 1 and Jane Luu 2
arxiv-2510-18769.description: Abstract We describe pre-perihelion optical observations of interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS taken during July - September 2025 using the Nordic Optical Telescope. Fixed aperture photometry of the comet is well described by a power law function of heliocentric distance, r H r_{H} , with the exponent (“index”) n = 3.8 ± 0.3 n=3.8\pm 0.3 across the 4.6 au to 1.

arxiv-2602-03042.title: Plasmonic Spin Meron Lattices with Height-Sensitive Topology Evolution Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2602-03042.creator: Anand Hegde, 1 Komal Gupta, 1 and Chen-Bin Huang 1,*
arxiv-2602-03042.description: Abstract We demonstrate height-controlled topological switching of plasmonic spin meron lattices above a metallic square coupling structure under circularly polarized illumination. Near the interface, an evanescent surface plasmon polariton (SPP) channel yields a Néel-type meron lattice with ± 1 2 \pm\tfrac{1}{2} -like effective site charges.

arxiv-2602-06926.title: Towards a Fully Automated Pipeline for Short-Term Forecasting of In Situ Coronal Mass Ejection Magnetic Field Structure Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2602-06926.creator: Hannah T. Rüdisser, Emma E. Davies, Ute V. Amerstorfer, Christian Möstl, Eva Weiler, Andreas J. Weiss, Justin Le Louëdec, Martin A. Reiss, Gautier Nguyen
arxiv-2602-06926.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hannah T. Rüdisser, Emma E. Davies, Ute V. Amerstorfer, Christian Möstl, Eva Weiler, Andreas J. Weiss, Justin Le Louëdec, Martin A. Reiss, Gautier Nguyen. We present an automated pipeline for operational short-term forecasting of coronal mass ejection (CME) magnetic field structure at L1, coupling arrival time prediction, in situ detection, and iterative flux rope reconstruction, following near-real-time remote-sensing CME identification.

arxiv-2602-10419.title: Equivariant Evidential Deep Learning for Interatomic Potentials
arxiv-2602-10419.creator: Zhongyao Wang, Taoyong Cui, Jiawen Zou, Shufei Zhang, Bo Yan, Wanli Ouyang, Weimin Tan † \dagger, Mao Su † \dagger
arxiv-2602-10419.description: Abstract Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is critical for assessing the reliability of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, identifying extrapolation regimes and enabling uncertainty-aware workflows such as active learning for training dataset construction. Existing UQ approaches for MLIPs are often limited by high computational cost or suboptimal performance.

europmc-pmc7402631.title: Structure-based design of prefusion-stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spikes.
europmc-pmc7402631.creator: Hsieh CL, Goldsmith JA, Schaub JM, DiVenere AM, Kuo HC, Javanmardi K, Le KC, Wrapp D, Lee AG, Liu Y, Chou CW, Byrne PO, Hjorth CK, Johnson NV, Ludes-Meyers J, Nguyen AW, Park J, Wang N, Amengor D, Lavinder JJ, Ippolito GC, Maynard JA, Finkelstein IJ, McLellan JS.
europmc-pmc7402631.description: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has led to accelerated efforts to develop therapeutics and vaccines. A key target of these efforts is the spike (S) protein, which is metastable and difficult to produce recombinantly. We characterized 100 structure-guided spike...

gao-gaoreports-gao-08-768.title: National Response Framework: FEMA Needs Policies and Procedures to Better Integrate Non-Federal Stakeholders in the Revision Process
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-768.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-768.description: National Response Framework: FEMA Needs Policies and Procedures to Better Integrate Non-Federal Stakeholders in the Revision Process (2008).

pmc-10610707.title: A Cloud-IoT Architecture for Latency-Aware Localization in Earthquake Early Warning
pmc-10610707.creator: Paola Pierleoni, Roberto Concetti, Alberto Belli, Lorenzo Palma, Simone Marzorati, Marco Esposito
pmc-10610707.description: An effective earthquake early warning system requires rapid and reliable earthquake source detection. Despite the numerous proposed epicenter localization solutions in recent years, their utilization within the Internet of Things (IoT) framework and integration with IoT-oriented cloud platforms remain underexplored. This paper proposes a complete IoT architecture for earthquake detection, localization, and event notification.

pmc-10742901.title: Radiation-Driven Polymerisation of Methacrylic Acid in Aqueous Solution: A Chemical Events Monte Carlo Study
pmc-10742901.creator: Aleksandras Sevcik, Zilvinas Rinkevicius, Diana Adliene, Rie Kakehashi, Yuji Yamashita
pmc-10742901.description: This study employed a coarse-grained Monte Carlo (MC) simulation to investigate the radiation-induced polymerisation of methacrylic acid (MAA) in an aqueous solution. This method provides an alternative to traditional kinetic models, enabling a detailed examination of the micro-structure and growth patterns of MAA polymers, which are often not captured in other approaches.

pmc-11361819.title: Restoration-oriented anatomical analysis of alveolar bone at mandibular first molars and implications for immediate implant placement surgery: a CBCT study
pmc-11361819.creator: Quan Shi, Yang Huang, Na Huo, Yi Jiang, Tong Zhang, Juncheng Wang
pmc-11361819.description: PURPOSEThis cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) study aimed to analyze the anatomical characteristics of alveolar bone at mandibular first molar (MFM) and their implications for immediate implant placement surgery.MATERIALS AND METHODS100 patients with 140 MFMs were reviewed retrospectively. We first performed a 3D reconstruction of the patient’s CBCT data to determine a reference plane with ideal implant placement and orientation.

pmc-11497608.title: Chirality and odd mechanics in active columnar phases
pmc-11497608.creator: S J Kole, Gareth P Alexander, Ananyo Maitra, Sriram Ramaswamy, Doraiswami Ramkrishna
pmc-11497608.description: Chiral active materials display odd dynamical effects in both their elastic and viscous responses. We show that the most symmetric mesophase with 2D odd elasticity in three dimensions is chiral, polar, and columnar, with 2D translational order in the plane perpendicular to the columns and no elastic restoring force for their relative sliding.

pmc-11539504.title: Acoustic black hole immersed sonoreactor for high-efficiency cavitation treatment
pmc-11539504.creator: Cheng Chen, Yang Liu, Chenghui Wang, Jianzhong Guo, Shuyu Lin
pmc-11539504.description: Developing innovative sonoreactors to enhance acoustic processing efficiency holds immense importance in the field of sonochemistry. Traditional immersed sonoreactors (TISs) mainly produce cavitation at the probe tip, with a relatively weak cavitation around the probe, resulting in posing challenges for high-efficiency cavitation treatment.

pmc-11638137.title: Association of Combined Autoreactivity to Sm/RNP Common Motif and U1 RNP With Mixed Connective Tissue Disease and Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
pmc-11638137.creator: Ruoning Ni, Aleksander Lenert, Petar Lenert
pmc-11638137.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the clinical features in patients with suspected connective tissue disease who tested positive for anti‐Sm/RNP common motif antibody with or without associated anti‐RNP antibody.MethodsThe titers of anti‐Sm/RNP and anti‐RNP antibodies were measured by the multiplex solid‐phase bioassays (Bio‐Rad).

pmc-11652380.title: Uptake of Measles Second Dose Vaccine and Its Associated Factors Among Children Age 24−35 Months in Merhabete Woreda, Ethiopia: 2022: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-11652380.creator: Ababye Mulatu Wmeskel, Melese Wagaye Zergaw, Hailegiyorgis Geleta Abocherugn
pmc-11652380.description: Background and AimMeasles infection in children causes a high degree of morbidity and mortality. Vaccination with two doses of measles vaccine is the best strategy to prevent infection and its spread to other children. However, measles containing vaccination coverage in Ethiopia is below the WHO elimination goal.

pmc-11658034.title: Flipping the script: The benefits of inverted classrooms in oncology education
pmc-11658034.creator: Zineb Dahbi, Mohammed Fareh, Ghassane Elomri, Moussaab Rachid, Bouchra Daher, Loubna Taali, Youssef Ghaddou
pmc-11658034.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ssions, problem solving, and group work. In medical education, the flipped classroom model can be an effective way to engage interns in active learning and give them the opportunity to apply what they have learned in real-world situations.[1]

The inverted classroom model can also help medical interns stay engaged and motivated because they have more control over their learning and can interact with their peers and instructors in real time.

pmc-11862550.title: Korean Medication Algorithm Project for Bipolar Disorder 2022: Treatment Strategy According to Safety and Tolerability
pmc-11862550.creator: S Y Park, W-M Bahk, Y S Woo, D-I Jon, M-D Kim, I Sohn
pmc-11862550.description: IntroductionAccordingly, the Korean Medication Algorithm Project for Bipolar Disorder (KMAP-BP) working committee, composed of domestic experts, developed Korea’s first KMAP-BP in 2002 and later in 2006, 2010, and 2010. A revised version of KMAP-BP was announced every four years four times in 2014 and 2018.6-10).

pmc-12361478.title: Ready-made bodily sensations
pmc-12361478.creator: Nicole Ruta, Gemma Schino, Brendan Wolfe, Marina Iosifyan
pmc-12361478.description: Embodiment plays an important role in art engagement, yet it is unclear how expectations shape bodily sensations, especially when interacting with ready-made art. In this study, we investigated how expectations and the nature of images of everyday objects affect bodily sensations.

pmc-12481622.title: A Global Survey on General Surgery Resident Involvement in Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery
pmc-12481622.creator: Adam Abu-Abeid, Wah Yang, Jonathan B Yuval
pmc-12481622.description: Background: There is limited global information on the involvement and autonomy of general surgery residents in metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS).Methods: We conducted an international online survey from July 15 to September 15, 2024, assessing residents’ participation in MBS procedures, outpatient clinics, simulation courses, mentorship, and research.

pmc-12564178.title: Adolescent Smartphone Overdependence in South Korea: A Place-Stratified Evaluation of Conceptually Informed AI/ML Modeling
pmc-12564178.creator: Andrew H. Kim, Uibin Lee, Yohan Cho, Sangmi Kim, Vatsal Shah
pmc-12564178.description: Smartphone overdependence among South Korean adolescents, affecting nearly 40%, poses a growing public health concern, with usage patterns varying by regional context. Leveraging conceptually informed AI/ML models, this study (1) develops a high-performing low-risk screening tool to monitor disease burden, (2) leverages AI/ML to explore psychologically meaningful constructs, and (3) provides place-based policy implication profiles to inform public health policy.

pmc-12950146.title: Integration of pathway balance and protein fusion enables de novo biosynthesis of (+)-bicyclogermacrene in Escherichia coli
pmc-12950146.creator: Chen-Yi Sun, Wen-Liang Xie, Zheng-Yu Huang, Chun-Xiu Li, Jian-He Xu
pmc-12950146.description: (+)-Bicyclogermacrene and its derivatives, with promising antimicrobial, anticancer, and insecticidal properties, hold significant potential for applications in pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and industry. However, traditional extraction methods from plant essential oils are unsustainable. In this study, we achieved the de novo biosynthesis of (+)-bicyclogermacrene using a metabolically engineered Escherichia coli strain.

pmc-12969061.title: Mental health and macroeconomics: economic and social determinants that explain suicide in Ecuador
pmc-12969061.creator: Anderson Argothy, David Ortiz, Carolina García Ramos, Alba Vargas Espín
pmc-12969061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSuicidal ideation and its most extreme outcome are important issues that should be studied from different theoretical approaches. Traditionally, it has been approached from the perspective of psychology; however, this study proposes an approach from the perspective of economics.

pmc-13080354.title: The percentage of normal glomeruli (“Normal” Glomerular Score) predicts kidney outcome in ANCA vasculitis
pmc-13080354.creator: Christos Chatzikyrkou, Carolin Herzog, Maximilian J Ganz, Thorsten Wiech, Hermann-Josef Gröne, Peter R Mertens, Florian G Scurt
pmc-13080354.description: BackgroundIn the management of anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (AAV), accurate prognostication of renal outcome is critical. However, the clinical utility of highly precise multi-variable models, such as the ANCA Kidney Risk Score (AKRiS), is often hampered by their complexity. This study aimed to validate a simple alternative: the “Normal” Glomerular Score (NGS), defined as the percentage of normal glomeruli.

pmc-13107136.title: Taxonomic update on the genus Unihamus Luo & Wang, 2025 (Blattidae, Blattinae), with three new species described
pmc-13107136.creator: Xin-Xing Luo, Meng-Yu Qiu, Ting-Ting Cai, Zong-Qing Wang, Yan-Li Che
pmc-13107136.description: Unihamus Luo & Wang, 2025 was recently split from Periplaneta sensu lato, yet its diversity and morphology remain poorly documented. Here we redescribe the type, Unihamus elegans (Hanitsch, 1927) and describe three new species, U. flavus Luo & Che, sp. nov., U. concavus Luo & Che, sp. nov., and U. longispinus Luo & Che, sp. nov.

pmc-13384016.title: Achiral guest-mediated modulation of circularly polarized luminescence in chiral charge-transfer cocrystals
pmc-13384016.creator: Jialin Cui, Yu Wang, Yujie Liu, Hui Liu, Wei Wang, Yingjie Zhao
pmc-13384016.description: Chiral charge-transfer (CT) systems provide an important platform for the development of circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) materials. However, precise modulation of CPL performance remains challenging. Herein, we report a host–guest supramolecular assembly strategy based on a naphthalene diimide-derived triangular macrocycle to construct a series of chiral CT single-crystal systems.

pmc-13588142.title: Financial strain contributes to daily depressive and anxiety symptoms in Hispanic and Latino family caregivers of people living with dementia: A daily diary study
pmc-13588142.creator: Kylie Meyer, Natashia Bibriescas, Abigail Poe, Megan Thomas Hebdon, Frank Puga
pmc-13588142.description: BACKGROUND:Family caregivers of people living with dementia (PLWD) face significant financial strain, which may adversely affect their mental health. While prior research links financial strain to depression and anxiety, few studies have explored its day-to-day impact, particularly among Hispanic and Latino (H&L) caregivers who experience high levels of financial strain.
